notes#r1.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the notes service (constant)]
  when [x2: note, x3: tag]
    request(e1, notes.add, subject: x1, object: x2)
    param(e1, title, some)
    param(e1, tag, x3)
  response
    under(x2, x3)
    keep(e2, subject: x4, object: x2)
notes#r1.line: When the person adds a note with a title and a tag, the notes service shall keep the note under the tag.

notes#r2.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the notes service (constant), x4: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical), x5: parameter title (constant)]
  if [x2: note]
    request(e1, notes.add, subject: x1, object: x2)
    noparam(e1, title)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    name(e3, subject: x3, object: x5)
notes#r2.line: If the person adds a note without a title, then the notes service shall refuse the request and name the title.

notes#r3.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x2: service the notes service (constant)]
  when
    request(e1, notes.list, subject: x1, the notes)
  response
    every [x3: note]
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x2, object: x3)
notes#r3.line: When the person lists the notes, the notes service shall return every note.

notes#r4.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the notes service (constant)]
  when [x2: note]
    request(e1, notes.remove, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x3, status(x2) = `removed`)
notes#r4.line: When the person removes a note, the notes service shall set the status of the note to `removed`.

U17.form:
shall []
  if [x1: service, x2: request]
    refuse(e1, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x3: reason]
    name(e2, subject: x1, object: x3)
    not [x4: thing]
      change(e3, subject: x1, object: x4)
U17.line: If a service refuses a request, then the service shall name a reason and change nothing.

U18.form:
shall []
  response [x1: session]
    not [x2: item]
      change(e1, subject: x1, object: x2)
U18.line: A session shall not change an item.

U19.form:
shall []
  while [x1: session, x2: workspace]
    of(x2, x1)
  response
    only [x3: file]
      in(x3, x2)
      scope
        change(e1, subject: x1, object: x3)
U19.line: While a session has a workspace, the session shall change only files in the workspace.

batches#r50.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x5: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
  when [x4: proposed change]
    of(x4, x2)
    request(e1, batches.merge, subject: x3, object: x4)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x5, status(x1) = `delivered`)
    initiates(e3, subject: x5, status(x2) = `merged`)
batches#r50.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch`, when the person merges the proposed change of the batch, the batches service shall set the status of the item to `delivered` and set the status of the batch to `merged`.

batches#r51.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the batches service (constant)]
  when [x2: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x4: batch brief]
    keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    return(e3, subject: x3, object: x4)
batches#r51.line: When the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep a batch brief and return the batch brief.

batches#r52.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the batches service (constant)]
  when [x2: batch]
    request(e1, batches.abandon, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    not [x4: review folder]
      of(x4, x2)
      keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
batches#r52.line: When the person abandons a batch, the batches service shall keep no review folder of the batch.

batches#r53.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    not [x3: dependency, x4: item]
      not
        status(x4) = `delivered`
      on(x3, x4)
      of(x3, x1)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response [x8: batch, x9: batch plan]
    initiates(e2, subject: x7, status(x1) = `in-batch`)
    in(x1, x8)
    keep(e3, subject: x7, object: x8)
    of(x9, x8)
    keep(e4, subject: x7, object: x9)
batches#r53.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and the item has no dependency on an item whose status is not `delivered`, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall set the status of the item to `in-batch`, keep a batch that holds the item and keep a batch plan of the batch.

batches#r54.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x3: agent the person (constant), x5: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    not
      meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
  when [x4: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x3, object: x4)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x5, status(x1) = `shaped`)
batches#r54.line: While an item is `ready` and the item does not meet the readiness bar, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall set the status of the item to `shaped`.

batches#r55.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x6: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: dependency, x3: item]
    not
      status(x1) = `ready`
    not
      status(x1) = `delivered`
    on(x2, x1)
    exists(x2)
    distinct(x3, x1)
    status(x3) = `ready`
    of(x2, x3)
  when [x5: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    not
      initiates(e2, subject: x6, status(x3) = `in-batch`)
batches#r55.line: While an item is not `ready` or `delivered` and a dependency on the item exists and another item whose status is `ready` has the dependency, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall not set the status of the item to `in-batch`.

batches#r56.form:
shall [x3: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch]
    status(x1) = `building`
  when [x2: session]
    request(e1, batches.resume, subject: x2, object: x1)
  response [x4: batch plan]
    of(x4, x1)
    return(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    not [x5: question]
      ask(e3, subject: x3, object: x5)
batches#r56.line: While a batch is `building`, when a session resumes the batch, the batches service shall return the batch plan of the batch and not ask a question.

batches#r57.form:
shall [x4: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
  when [x3: session]
    request(e1, batches.park, subject: x3, object: x1)
  response [x5: question]
    initiates(e2, subject: x4, status(x1) = `needs-input`)
    on(x5, x1)
    keep(e3, subject: x4, object: x5)
    not
      initiates(e4, subject: x4, status(x2) = `abandoned`)
batches#r57.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch`, when a session parks the item, the batches service shall set the status of the item to `needs-input`, keep a question on the item and not set the status of the batch to `abandoned`.

batches#r58.form:
shall [x2: agent the person (constant), x3: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch]
    status(x1) = `building`
  when
    request(e1, batches.abandon, subject: x2, object: x1)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x3, status(x1) = `abandoned`)
    every [x4: item]
      in(x4, x1)
      status(x4) = `in-batch`
      scope
        initiates(e3, subject: x3, status(x4) = `ready`)
batches#r58.line: While a batch is `building`, when the person abandons the batch, the batches service shall set the status of the batch to `abandoned` and set the status of every item in the batch whose status is `in-batch` to `ready`.

batches#r59.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the batches service (constant)]
  when [x2: batch, x3: proposed change]
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, batches.merge, subject: x1, object: x3)
  response
    not [x5: review folder]
      of(x5, x2)
      keep(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
batches#r59.line: When the person merges the proposed change of a batch, the batches service shall keep no review folder of the batch.

batches#r60.form:
shall [x6: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: workspace, x4: requirement]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
    of(x3, x2)
    of(x4, x1)
    in(x4, x3)
  when [x5: session]
    request(e1, batches.park, subject: x5, object: x1)
  response [x7: workspace]
    of(x7, x2)
    not
      in(x4, x7)
    keep(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
batches#r60.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch` and the workspace of the batch holds a requirement of the item, when a session parks the item, the batches service shall keep a workspace of the batch that does not hold the requirement.

batches#r61.form:
shall [x8: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: task, x4: item, x5: scenario, x6: workspace]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
    of(x3, x1)
    status(x3) = `running`
    in(x4, x2)
    status(x4) = `needs-input`
    of(x5, x4)
    of(x6, x3)
    break(subject: x5, in: x6)
  when [x7: session]
    request(e1, batches.finish, subject: x7, object: x3)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x8, status(x3) = `done`)
batches#r61.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch` and a task of the item is `running` and the status of an item in the batch is `needs-input` and a scenario of the item breaks in the workspace of the task, when a session finishes the task, the batches service shall set the status of the task to `done`.

batches#r62.form:
shall [x8: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: task, x4: item, x5: scenario, x6: workspace]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
    of(x3, x1)
    status(x3) = `running`
    distinct(x4, x1)
    in(x4, x2)
    status(x4) = `in-batch`
    of(x5, x4)
    of(x6, x3)
    succeed(subject: x5, in: x6)
  when [x7: session]
    request(e1, batches.finish, subject: x7, object: x3)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x8, status(x3) = `done`)
batches#r62.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch` and a task of the item is `running` and another item in the batch is `in-batch` and a scenario of the item succeeds in the workspace of the task, when a session finishes the task, the batches service shall set the status of the task to `done`.

batches#r63.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch, x2: item, x3: task]
    in(x2, x1)
    of(x3, x1)
  when
    request(e1, batches.monitor, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response [x6: status]
    return(e2, subject: x5, object: x2)
    return(e3, subject: x5, object: x3)
    status(x3) = x6
    return(e4, subject: x5, object: x6)
batches#r63.line: While a batch holds an item and the batch has a task, when the person monitors the batch, the batches service shall return the item, the task and the status of the task.

batches#r64.form:
shall [x1: capability `universal` (constant), x3: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x2: item, x4: universal condition]
    not
      exists(x1)
    status(x2) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x2, object: x3)
    in(x4, x2)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x1)
    initiates(e3, subject: x7, language(x1) = `codified-2`)
batches#r64.line: While `universal` does not exist and an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and a universal condition is in the item, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep `universal` and set the language of `universal` to `codified-2`.

batches#r65.form:
shall [x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: request line, x4: context request]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
    of(x3, x4)
    of(x3, x1)
    status(x4) = `accepted`
  when [x6: proposed change]
    of(x6, x2)
    request(e1, batches.merge, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response [x8: resolution, x9: entry]
    initiates(e2, subject: x7, status(x4) = `delivered`)
    keep(e3, subject: x7, object: x8)
    initiates(e4, subject: x7, side(x4) = `asker`)
    on(x9, x4)
    keep(e5, subject: x7, object: x9)
batches#r65.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch` and the item has a request line of a context request and the context request is `accepted`, when the person merges the proposed change of the batch, the batches service shall set the status of the context request to `delivered`, keep a resolution, set the side of the context request to `asker` and keep an entry on the context request.

batches#r66.form:
shall [x6: service the batches service (constant), x7: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: task, x2: item, x3: chore, x4: workspace]
    of(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `running`
    in(x3, x2)
    of(x4, x1)
    break(subject: x3, in: x4)
  if [x5: session]
    request(e1, batches.finish, subject: x5, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
    name(e3, subject: x6, object: x3)
batches#r66.line: While a task of an item is `running` and the item holds a chore and the chore breaks in the workspace of the task, if a session finishes the task, then the batches service shall refuse the request and name the chore.

batches#r67.form:
shall [x8: service the batches service (constant), x9: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: task, x2: item, x3: chore, x4: kept change, x5: workspace, x6: file]
    of(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `running`
    in(x3, x2)
    of(x5, x1)
    in(x4, x5)
    not
      in(x6, x3)
    touch(subject: x4, object: x6)
  if [x7: session]
    request(e1, batches.finish, subject: x7, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x8, object: x9)
    name(e3, subject: x8, object: x6)
batches#r67.line: While a task of an item is `running` and the item holds a chore and a kept change in the workspace of the task touches a file that is not in the chore, if a session finishes the task, then the batches service shall refuse the request and name the file.

batches#r68.form:
shall [x3: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x4: agent the person (constant), x6: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: chore]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    in(x2, x1)
    meet(subject: x1, object: x3)
  when [x5: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response [x7: batch brief]
    in(x2, x7)
    keep(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
batches#r68.line: While an item is `ready` and the item holds a chore and the item meets the readiness bar, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep a batch brief that holds the chore.

batches#r70.form:
shall [x10: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: task, x4: item, x5: requirement, x6: workspace, x7: scenario, x8: workspace]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
    of(x3, x1)
    status(x3) = `running`
    in(x4, x2)
    status(x4) = `needs-input`
    of(x6, x2)
    not
      in(x5, x6)
    of(x5, x4)
    of(x7, x4)
    of(x8, x3)
    break(subject: x7, in: x8)
  when [x9: session]
    request(e1, batches.finish, subject: x9, object: x3)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x10, status(x3) = `done`)
batches#r70.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch` and a task of the item is `running` and the status of an item in the batch is `needs-input` and the item has a requirement that is not in the workspace of the batch and a scenario of the item breaks in the workspace of the task, when a session finishes the task, the batches service shall set the status of the task to `done`.

batches#r71.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant), x8: corpus "the corpus of the bounded context the command runs in" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x3: requirement, x4: logical form]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    of(x3, x1)
    of(x4, x3)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response
    in(x4, x8)
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x4)
batches#r71.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and a requirement of the item has a logical form, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep the logical form in the corpus.

batches#r72.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: corpus "the corpus of the bounded context the command runs in" (indexical), x6: agent the person (constant), x8: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x3: requirement id, x4: requirement]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    in(x3, x1)
    in(x4, x5)
    of(x3, x4)
  when [x7: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x6, object: x7)
  response [x9: corpus]
    not
      in(x4, x9)
    keep(e2, subject: x8, object: x9)
batches#r72.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and a requirement id is in the item and a requirement in the corpus has the requirement id, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep a corpus that does not hold the requirement.

batches#r73.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x3: requirement, x4: rule]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    of(x3, x1)
    use(subject: x3, object: x4)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response [x8: catalogue entry]
    of(x8, x4)
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
batches#r73.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and a requirement of the item uses a rule, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep the catalogue entry of the rule.

batches#r74.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant), x8: construct catalogue "the construct catalogue of the bounded context the command runs in" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x3: requirement, x4: construct]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    of(x3, x1)
    use(subject: x3, object: x4)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
batches#r74.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and a requirement of the item uses a construct, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep the construct catalogue.

batches#r75.form:
shall [x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant)]
  while
    not [x1: requirement, x2: item, x3: construct]
      status(x2) = `ready`
      of(x1, x2)
      use(subject: x1, object: x3)
    not [x4: construct catalogue]
      exists(x4)
  when [x6: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response
    not [x8: construct catalogue]
      keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
batches#r75.line: While no requirement of an item whose status is `ready` uses a construct and no construct catalogue exists, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep no construct catalogue.

batches#r76.form:
shall [x2: readiness bar "the readiness bar of the plugin that runs the command" (indexical), x4: agent the person (constant), x6: service the batches service (constant), x7: artifact the capability form (constant), x9: artifact the index form (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x3: capability]
    status(x1) = `ready`
    meet(subject: x1, object: x2)
    in(x3, x1)
  when [x5: batch]
    request(e1, batches.open, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response [x8: index file]
    conforms(x3, x7)
    keep(e2, subject: x6, object: x3)
    conforms(x8, x9)
    keep(e3, subject: x6, object: x8)
batches#r76.line: While an item is `ready` and the item meets the readiness bar and the item holds a capability, when the person opens a batch, the batches service shall keep the capability that conforms to the capability form and keep an index file that conforms to the index form.

checking#r1.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x2: rule catalogue "the rule catalogue of the plugin" (indexical), x3: service the specification service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  when
    request(e1, specification.consult, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    every [x4: rule]
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    complete(e3, subject: x3, object: x5)
checking#r1.line: When the person consults the rule catalogue, the specification service shall return every rule and complete the request.

checking#r18.form:
shall [x2: artifact the request form (constant), x3: agent the person (constant), x4: specification "the specification of this bounded context" (indexical), x5: service the specification service (constant), x6: check "the check the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: request]
    not
      conforms(x1, x2)
  if
    request(e1, specification.check, subject: x3, object: x4)
  response
    fail(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    name(e3, subject: x5, object: x1)
checking#r18.line: While a request does not conform to the request form, if the person validates this specification, then the specification service shall fail the check and name the request.

checking#r19.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: specification "the specification of this bounded context" (indexical), x6: service the specification service (constant), x7: check "the check the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: scenario, x2: requirement id, x3: capability]
    of(x3, x1)
    not
      in(x2, x3)
    refer(subject: x1, to: x2)
  if
    request(e1, specification.check, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    fail(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
    name(e3, subject: x6, object: x1)

decisions#r19.line: While no decisions index lacks an index entry, when the person rebuilds the decisions index with the audit, the decisions service shall complete the request.

decisions#r2.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: specification "the specification of this bounded context" (indexical), x5: service the specification service (constant), x6: check "the check the trigger makes" (indexical), x7: thing `v_d6` (parameter)]
  while [x1: design-decision]

decisions#r4.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: decisions index "the decisions index of this bounded context" (indexical), x5: service the decisions service (constant)]

decisions#r6.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: specification "the specification of this bounded context" (indexical), x5: service the specification service (constant), x6: check "the check the trigger makes" (indexical), x7: thing `v_d8` (parameter)]

directives#r1.form:

items#r29.line: When a session starts, the backlog service shall notify the session of every item, every title of an item and every batch.

items#r3.form:
shall [x2: agent the person (constant), x3: service the backlog service (constant), x4: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item]
    not
      status(x1) = `shaped`
  if
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x2, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    name(e3, subject: x3, object: x1)
items#r3.line: While an item is not `shaped`, if the person readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name the item.

items#r30.form:
shall [x4: service the backlog service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x2: request line]
    status(x1) = `shaped`
    of(x2, x1)
    not
      line outcome(x2) = `accepted`
    not
      line outcome(x2) = `refused`
    not
      line outcome(x2) = `withdrawn`
  if [x3: session]
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x3, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x2)
items#r30.line: While an item is `shaped` and a request line of the item is not `accepted`, `refused` or `withdrawn`, if a session readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name the request line.

items#r4.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the backlog service (constant)]
  when [x2: item]
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    not [x4: question]
      ask(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
items#r4.line: When the person readies an item, the backlog service shall not ask a question.

items#r5.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the backlog service (constant), x6: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x2: term, x3: rule]
    status(x1) = `shaped`
    in(x2, x1)
    violate(subject: x2, object: x3)
  if
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    name(e3, subject: x5, object: x2)
    name(e4, subject: x5, object: x3)
items#r5.line: While an item is `shaped` and a term in the item violates a rule, if the person readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name the term and the rule.

items#r6.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the backlog service (constant), x6: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x2: requirement]
    status(x1) = `shaped`
    in(x2, x1)
    not [x3: translation]
      of(x3, x2)
  if
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    name(e3, subject: x5, object: x2)
items#r6.line: While an item is `shaped` and a requirement in the item has no translation, if the person readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name the requirement.

items#r7.form:
shall [x1: capability `universal` (constant), x5: agent the person (constant), x6: service the backlog service (constant), x7: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x2: item, x3: universal condition]
    not
      exists(x1)
    status(x2) = `shaped`
    in(x3, x2)
    not [x4: translation]
      of(x4, x3)
  if
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x5, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
    name(e3, subject: x6, object: x3)
items#r7.line: While `universal` does not exist and an item is `shaped` and a universal condition in the item has no translation, if the person readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name the universal condition.

items#r8.form:
shall [x6: agent the person (constant), x7: service the backlog service (constant), x8: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: item, x2: requirement, x4: requirement]
    status(x1) = `shaped`
    in(x2, x1)
    not [x3: parse]
      of(x3, x2)
    distinct(x4, x2)
    in(x4, x1)
    not [x5: translation]
      of(x5, x4)
  if
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x6, object: x1)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
    every [x9: requirement]
      in(x9, x1)
      not [x10: parse]
        of(x10, x9)
      scope
        name(e3, subject: x7, object: x9)
    every [x11: requirement]
      in(x11, x1)
      not [x12: translation]
        of(x12, x11)
      scope
        name(e4, subject: x7, object: x11)
items#r8.line: While an item is `shaped` and a requirement in the item has no parse and a different requirement in the item has no translation, if the person readies the item, then the backlog service shall refuse the request and name every requirement in the item that has no parse and every requirement in the item that has no translation.

items#r9.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the backlog service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: chore]
    status(x1) = `shaped`
    in(x2, x1)
    not [x3: requirement]
      in(x3, x1)
  when
    request(e1, backlog.ready, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x5, status(x1) = `ready`)
items#r9.line: While an item is `shaped` and the item holds a chore and the item holds no requirement, when the person readies the item, the backlog service shall set the status of the item to `ready`.

measurement#r1.form:
shall [x2: agent the person (constant), x3: service the measurement service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch]
    status(x1) = `merged`
  when
    request(e1, measurement.measure, subject: x2, object: x1)
  response [x4: measurement, x5: wall time, x6: session time, x7: token]
    of(x4, x1)
    keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    of(x5, x1)
    return(e3, subject: x3, object: x5)
    of(x6, x1)
    return(e4, subject: x3, object: x6)
    of(x7, x1)
    return(e5, subject: x3, object: x7)
    every [x8: role]
      of(x8, x1)
      scope [x9: cost]
        of(x9, x8)
        return(e6, subject: x3, object: x9)
measurement#r1.line: While a batch is `merged`, when the person measures the batch, the measurement service shall keep a measurement of the batch and return the wall time of the batch, the session time of the batch, the tokens of the batch and the cost of every role of the batch.

measurement#r10.line: When the person compares a batch with another batch, the measurement service shall return two measurements and a ratio.

measurement#r11.line: When the person compares a measurement with another measurement, the measurement service shall return two total rows and a ratio.

measurement#r2.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the measurement service (constant)]
  when [x2: batch, x3: proposed change]
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, measurement.measure, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x5: measurement, x6: number, x8: number, x10: number]
    of(x5, x2)
    keep(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    number x6 of [x7: review finding]
      on(x7, x3)
      grade(x7) = `Critical`
    return(e3, subject: x4, object: x6)
    number x8 of [x9: review finding]
      on(x9, x3)
      grade(x9) = `Important`
    return(e4, subject: x4, object: x8)
    number x10 of [x11: review finding]
      on(x11, x3)
      grade(x11) = `Minor`
    return(e5, subject: x4, object: x10)
measurement#r2.line: When the person measures a batch that has a proposed change, the measurement service shall keep a measurement of the batch and return the number of review findings on the proposed change whose grade is `Critical`, the number of review findings on the proposed change whose grade is `Important` and the number of review findings on the proposed change whose grade is `Minor`.

measurement#r3.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x5: service the measurement service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `delivered`
  when [x4: defect]
    request(e1, measurement.report, subject: x3, object: x4, in: x1)
  response [x6: defect]
    for(x6, x2)
    of(x6, x1)
    keep(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
measurement#r3.line: While an item in a batch is `delivered`, when the person reports a defect in the item, the measurement service shall keep a defect for the batch that the item has.

measurement#r5.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x5: service the measurement service (constant)]
  when [x2: measurement, x3: stage row, x4: round trip]
    of(x4, x3)
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, measurement.view, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x6: number, x9: total row]
    number x6 of [x7: round trip]
      of(x7, x3)
    return(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    every [x8: stage row]
      of(x8, x2)
      scope
        return(e3, subject: x5, object: x8)
    of(x9, x2)
    return(e4, subject: x5, object: x9)
measurement#r5.line: When the person views a measurement that has a stage row that has a round trip, the measurement service shall return the number of round trips of the stage row, every stage row of the measurement and the total row of the measurement.

measurement#r6.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x5: service the measurement service (constant)]
  when [x2: measurement, x3: stage row]
    not [x4: round trip]
      of(x4, x3)
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, measurement.view, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    every [x6: stage row]
      of(x6, x2)
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    not [x7: round trip]
      return(e3, subject: x5, object: x7)
measurement#r6.line: When the person views a measurement that has a stage row that has no round trip, the measurement service shall return every stage row of the measurement and not return a round trip.

measurement#r7.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the measurement service (constant)]
  when [x2: measurement, x3: session row]
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, measurement.view, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x5: number, x8: number]
    number x5 of [x6: tool use]
      of(x6, x3)
    return(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    every [x7: dispatch]
      of(x7, x3)
      scope
        return(e3, subject: x4, object: x7)
    number x8 of [x9: compaction]
      of(x9, x3)
    return(e4, subject: x4, object: x8)
measurement#r7.line: When the person views a measurement that has a session row, the measurement service shall return the number of tool uses of the session row, every dispatch of the session row and the number of compactions of the session row.

measurement#r9.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the measurement service (constant)]
  when [x2: measurement, x3: session row]
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, measurement.compare, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x5: number, x7: number]
    number x5 of [x6: tool use]
      in(x6, x2)
    return(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    number x7 of [x8: compaction]
      in(x8, x2)
    return(e3, subject: x4, object: x7)
measurement#r9.line: When the person compares a measurement that has a session row, the measurement service shall return the number of tool uses in the measurement and the number of compactions in the measurement.

parsing#r1.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: artifact the language reference (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  when [x2: requirement]
    conforms(x2, x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    complete(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
parsing#r1.line: When the person parses a requirement that conforms to the language reference, the language service shall complete the request.

parsing#r10.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the language service (constant), x7: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: requirement, x2: parse]
    not [x3: parse cache]
      in(x2, x3)
    of(x2, x1)
  when
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response [x6: parse cache]
    keep(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    complete(e3, subject: x5, object: x7)
parsing#r10.line: While a requirement has a parse that no parse cache holds, when the person parses the requirement, the language service shall keep a parse cache and complete the request.

parsing#r11.form:
shall [x5: agent the person (constant), x6: service the language service (constant), x8: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: requirement, x2: parse, x4: compiled grammar]
    not [x3: parse cache]
      in(x2, x3)
    of(x2, x1)
    of(x4, x1)
    exists(x4)
  when
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x5, object: x1)
  response
    not [x7: compiled grammar]
      keep(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
    complete(e3, subject: x6, object: x8)
parsing#r11.line: While a requirement has a parse that no parse cache holds and the compiled grammar of the requirement exists, when the person parses the requirement, the language service shall keep no compiled grammar and complete the request.

parsing#r12.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: thing `order-by` (parameter), x4: service the language service (constant)]
  when [x2: requirement]
    use(subject: x2, object: x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
    param(e1, logical form, on)
  response [x5: logical form, x6: order, x7: member, x8: collection]
    of(x7, x8)
    of(x6, x7)
    use(subject: x5, object: x6)
    return(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
parsing#r12.line: When the person parses a requirement that uses `order-by` with the logical form, the language service shall return a logical form that uses an order of a member of a collection.

parsing#r13.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x7: service the language service (constant), x9: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: verb, x2: frame, x3: frame]
    of(x2, x1)
    distinct(x3, x2)
    of(x3, x1)
  when [x5: requirement, x6: frame]
    of(x6, x1)
    use(subject: x5, object: x6)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    count exactly 1 [x8: logical form]
      of(x8, x5)
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
    complete(e3, subject: x7, object: x9)
parsing#r13.line: While a verb has two frames, when the person parses a requirement that uses a frame of the verb, the language service shall return one logical form of the requirement and complete the request.

parsing#r14.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement, x3: plural object]
    of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x2)
parsing#r14.line: If the person parses a requirement that has a plural object, then the language service shall refuse the request and name the requirement.

parsing#r15.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement]
    count more than 1 [x3: logical form]
      scope
        of(x3, x2)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x6: ambiguous text]
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x2)
    of(x6, x2)
    name(e4, subject: x4, object: x6)
parsing#r15.line: If the person parses a requirement that has more than one logical form, then the language service shall refuse the request and name the requirement and the ambiguous text of the requirement.

parsing#r16.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x7: service the language service (constant), x8: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement, x3: ambiguous text, x4: frame, x5: verb, x6: frame]
    of(x3, x2)
    of(x4, x5)
    use(subject: x3, object: x4)
    distinct(x6, x4)
    of(x6, x5)
    use(subject: x3, object: x6)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
    every [x9: frame]
      use(subject: x3, object: x9)
      scope
        name(e3, subject: x7, object: x9)
parsing#r16.line: If the person parses a requirement whose ambiguous text uses two frames of a verb, then the language service shall refuse the request and name every frame that the ambiguous text uses.

parsing#r17.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: thing `param-of` (parameter), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  when [x2: requirement]
    use(subject: x2, object: x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    complete(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
parsing#r17.line: When the person parses a requirement that uses `param-of`, the language service shall complete the request.

parsing#r18.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: thing `param-of` (parameter), x4: service the language service (constant)]
  when [x2: requirement]
    use(subject: x2, object: x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
    param(e1, logical form, on)
  response [x5: logical form, x6: value in use]
    in(x6, x5)
    return(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
parsing#r18.line: When the person parses a requirement that uses `param-of` with the logical form, the language service shall return a logical form that holds a value in use.

parsing#r2.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: artifact the language reference (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x6: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  when [x2: requirement]
    conforms(x2, x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
    param(e1, logical form, on)
  response
    count exactly 1 [x5: logical form]
      of(x5, x2)
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    complete(e3, subject: x4, object: x6)
parsing#r2.line: When the person parses a requirement that conforms to the language reference with the logical form, the language service shall return one logical form of the requirement and complete the request.

parsing#r3.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: artifact the language reference (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement]
    not
      conforms(x2, x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x2)
parsing#r3.line: If the person parses a requirement that does not conform to the language reference, then the language service shall refuse the request and name the requirement.

parsing#r5.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: service the language service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement, x3: reading rule]
    violate(subject: x2, object: x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x3)
parsing#r5.line: If the person parses a requirement that violates a reading rule, then the language service shall refuse the request and name the reading rule.

parsing#r6.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x5: service the language service (constant), x6: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: requirement, x3: construct]
    not [x4: catalogue entry]
      of(x4, x3)
    use(subject: x2, object: x3)
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
    name(e3, subject: x5, object: x3)
parsing#r6.line: If the person parses a requirement that uses a construct that has no catalogue entry, then the language service shall refuse the request and name the construct.

parsing#r7.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the language service (constant), x4: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: fragment]
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x5: term]
    refuse(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    name(e3, subject: x3, object: x2)
    return(e4, subject: x3, object: x5)
parsing#r7.line: If the person parses a fragment, then the language service shall refuse the request, name the fragment and return a term.

parsing#r8.form:
shall [x1: corpus "the corpus of the bounded context the command runs in" (indexical), x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the language service (constant)]
  while [x2: logical form, x3: requirement]
    of(x2, x3)
    in(x2, x1)
  when
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x4, object: x3)
    param(e1, logical form, on)
  response
    return(e2, subject: x5, object: x2)
parsing#r8.line: While the corpus holds a logical form of a requirement, when the person parses the requirement with the logical form, the language service shall return the logical form.

parsing#r9.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the language service (constant), x7: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: parse cache, x2: requirement, x3: parse]
    of(x3, x2)
    in(x3, x1)
  when
    request(e1, language.parse, subject: x4, object: x2)
  response
    return(e2, subject: x5, object: x3)
    not [x6: compiled grammar]
      keep(e3, subject: x5, object: x6)
    complete(e4, subject: x5, object: x7)
parsing#r9.line: While a parse cache holds the parse of a requirement, when the person parses the requirement, the language service shall return the parse of the requirement, keep no compiled grammar and complete the request.

quotes#r1.form:
shall [x3: service the conversation service (constant)]
  when [x1: session, x2: message]
    request(e1, conversation.quote, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x4: quote]
    from(x4, x1)
    cite(subject: x4, object: x2)
    keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
quotes#r1.line: When a session quotes a message, the conversation service shall keep a quote from the session that cites the message.

quotes#r2.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the conversation service (constant)]
  when [x2: session]
    request(e1, conversation.prompt, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x4: transcript]
    of(x4, x2)
    keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
quotes#r2.line: When the person prompts a session, the conversation service shall keep the transcript of the session.

quotes#r3.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the conversation service (constant)]
  when [x2: quote]
    request(e1, conversation.read, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    every [x4: message]
      cite(subject: x2, object: x4)
      scope
        return(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
quotes#r3.line: When the person reads a quote, the conversation service shall return every message that the quote cites.

quotes#r4.form:
shall [x3: service the conversation service (constant)]
  when [x1: session, x2: queued message]
    request(e1, conversation.quote, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x4: quote]
    cite(subject: x4, object: x2)
    keep(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
    return(e3, subject: x3, object: x4)
quotes#r4.line: When a session quotes a queued message, the conversation service shall keep a quote that cites the queued message and return the quote.

records#r1.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x3: service the records service (constant)]
  when [x2: record]

records#r1.line: When the person files a record, the records service shall keep the record.

records#r2.form:
shall [x1: agent the person (constant), x4: artifact the node id form (constant), x5: service the records service (constant), x6: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  if [x2: record, x3: text]

records#r2.line: If the person files a record with a text that does not conform to the node id form, then the records service shall refuse the request and name the text.

request-watch#r1.form:
shall [x3: artifact the entry form (constant), x5: bounded context "the bounded context whose repository the command runs in" (indexical), x6: service the context requests service (constant), x7: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: entry, x2: context request]
    on(x1, x2)
    conforms(x1, x3)
    not
      in(x1, x2)
  when [x4: session]
    request(e1, context requests.watch, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    notify(e2, subject: x6, object: x4, of: x1)
    complete(e3, subject: x6, object: x7)
    not
      keep(e4, subject: x6, object: x1)
request-watch#r1.line: While an entry on a context request conforms to the entry form and the context request does not hold the entry, when a session watches this bounded context, the context requests service shall notify the session of the entry, complete the request and not keep the entry.

request-watch#r2.form:
shall [x2: bounded context "the bounded context whose repository the command runs in" (indexical), x4: artifact the entry form (constant), x7: service the context requests service (constant), x8: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: thread, x3: channel]
    of(x3, x2)
    on(x1, x3)
    status(x1) = `open`
    conforms(x1, x4)
    not [x5: context request]
      of(x1, x5)
  when [x6: session]
    request(e1, context requests.watch, subject: x6, object: x2)
  response
    notify(e2, subject: x7, object: x6, of: x1)
    complete(e3, subject: x7, object: x8)
request-watch#r2.line: While a thread on the channel of this bounded context is `open` and the thread conforms to the entry form and no context request has the thread, when a session watches this bounded context, the context requests service shall notify the session of the thread and complete the request.

request-watch#r3.form:
shall [x2: bounded context "the bounded context whose repository the command runs in" (indexical), x4: service the context requests service (constant)]
  while [x1: context request]
    originate(subject: x1, from: x2)
    not
      address(subject: x1, object: x2)
    status(x1) = `awaiting-upstream`
  when [x3: session]
    start(e1, subject: x3)
  response
    notify(e2, subject: x4, object: x3, of: x1)
request-watch#r3.line: While a context request originates from this bounded context and the context request does not address this bounded context and the context request is `awaiting-upstream`, when a session starts, the context requests service shall notify the session of the context request.

request-watch#r4.form:
shall [x2: bounded context "the bounded context whose repository the command runs in" (indexical), x4: service the context requests service (constant)]
  while [x1: context request]
    address(subject: x1, object: x2)
    not
      originate(subject: x1, from: x2)
    status(x1) = `awaiting-asker`
  when [x3: session]
    start(e1, subject: x3)
  response
    notify(e2, subject: x4, object: x3, of: x1)
request-watch#r4.line: While a context request addresses this bounded context and the context request does not originate from this bounded context and the context request is `awaiting-asker`, when a session starts, the context requests service shall notify the session of the context request.

request-watch#r5.form:
shall [x2: bounded context "the bounded context whose repository the command runs in" (indexical), x5: service the context requests service (constant)]
  while
    not [x1: context request]
      originate(subject: x1, from: x2)
      status(x1) = `awaiting-upstream`
    not [x3: context request]
      address(subject: x3, object: x2)
      status(x3) = `awaiting-asker`
  when [x4: session]
    start(e1, subject: x4)
  response
    not [x6: context request]
      notify(e2, subject: x5, object: x4, of: x6)
request-watch#r5.line: While no context request that originates from this bounded context is `awaiting-upstream` and no context request that addresses this bounded context is `awaiting-asker`, when a session starts, the context requests service shall not notify the session of a context request.

request-watch#r6.form:
shall [x3: artifact the entry form (constant), x5: service the context requests service (constant)]
  while [x1: entry, x2: context request]
    on(x1, x2)
    not
      conforms(x1, x3)
    not
      in(x1, x2)
  when [x4: session]
    request(e1, context requests.catch up, subject: x4)
  response [x6: status]
    notify(e2, subject: x5, object: x4, of: x1)
    keep(e3, subject: x5, object: x1)
    status(x2) = x6
    keep(e4, subject: x5, object: x6)
request-watch#r6.line: While an entry on a context request does not conform to the entry form and the context request does not hold the entry, when a session catches up, the context requests service shall notify the session of the entry, keep the entry and keep the status of the context request.

request-watch#r7.form:
shall [x3: artifact the entry form (constant), x5: service the context requests service (constant)]
  while [x1: entry, x2: context request]
    on(x1, x2)
    not
      conforms(x1, x3)
    in(x1, x2)
  when [x4: session]
    request(e1, context requests.catch up, subject: x4)
  response
    not
      notify(e2, subject: x5, object: x4, of: x1)
request-watch#r7.line: While an entry on a context request does not conform to the entry form and the context request holds the entry, when a session catches up, the context requests service shall not notify the session of the entry.

review-guarantees#r1.form:
shall [x1: service the batches service (constant), x3: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  when [x2: batch]
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response [x4: proposed change]
    of(x4, x2)
    review(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
review-guarantees#r1.line: When the batches service submits a batch, `pr-reviewer` shall review the proposed change of the batch.

review-guarantees#r2.form:
shall [x2: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  while [x1: design-decision]
    tier(x1) = `judgement`
  when [x3: proposed change]
    request(e1, reviews.review, subject: x2, object: x3)
  response
    review(e2, subject: x2, object: x1)
review-guarantees#r2.line: While the tier of a design-decision is `judgement`, when `pr-reviewer` reviews a proposed change, `pr-reviewer` shall review the design-decision.

review-guarantees#r3.form:
shall [x1: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  response
    only [x2: review, x3: proposed change]
      of(x2, x3)
      scope
        change(e1, subject: x1, object: x2)
review-guarantees#r3.line: `pr-reviewer` shall change only reviews of a proposed change.

review-guarantees#r4.form:
shall [x4: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  while [x1: proposed change, x2: batch]
    of(x1, x2)
    not [x3: review]
      of(x3, x1)
  when
    request(e1, reviews.review, subject: x4, object: x1)
  response
    every [x5: requirement, x6: item]
      in(x6, x2)
      propose(subject: x6, object: x5)
      scope
        review(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    every [x7: kept change]
      of(x7, x2)
      scope
        review(e3, subject: x4, object: x7)
review-guarantees#r4.line: While a proposed change of a batch has no review, when `pr-reviewer` reviews the proposed change, `pr-reviewer` shall review every requirement that an item in the batch proposes and every kept change of the batch.

review-guarantees#r5.form:
shall [x1: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  when [x2: proposed change, x3: batch]
    of(x2, x3)
    request(e1, reviews.review, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    only [x4: kept change]
      of(x4, x3)
      scope
        review(e2, subject: x1, object: x4)
review-guarantees#r5.line: When `pr-reviewer` reviews a proposed change of a batch, `pr-reviewer` shall review only kept changes of the batch.

review-guarantees#r6.form:
shall [x6: service the reviews service (constant)]
  while [x1: review finding, x2: batch, x3: proposed change]
    of(x3, x2)
    on(x1, x3)
    triage(x1) = `fix now`
  when [x4: session, x5: review]
    of(x5, x2)
    request(e1, reviews.conclude, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x6, status(x2) = `building`)
review-guarantees#r6.line: While the triage of a review finding on the proposed change of a batch is `fix now`, when a session concludes a review of the batch, the reviews service shall set the status of the batch to `building`.

review-guarantees#r7.form:
shall [x3: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  while [x1: review finding, x2: proposed change]
    on(x1, x2)
    triage(x1) = `fix now`
  when
    request(e1, reviews.review, subject: x3, object: x2)
  response
    every [x4: kept change]
      for(x4, x1)
      scope
        review(e2, subject: x3, object: x4)
review-guarantees#r7.line: While the triage of a review finding on a proposed change is `fix now`, when `pr-reviewer` reviews the proposed change, `pr-reviewer` shall review every kept change for the review finding.

review-guarantees#r8.form:
shall [x6: service the reviews service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch, x2: proposed change]
    of(x2, x1)
    not [x3: review finding]
      on(x3, x2)
      triage(x3) = `fix now`
      exists(x3)
  when [x4: session, x5: review]
    of(x5, x1)
    request(e1, reviews.conclude, subject: x4, object: x5)
  response
    initiates(e2, subject: x6, status(x1) = `awaiting-merge`)
review-guarantees#r8.line: While a batch has a proposed change and no review finding on the proposed change whose triage is `fix now` exists, when a session concludes a review of the batch, the reviews service shall set the status of the batch to `awaiting-merge`.

review-guarantees#r9.form:
shall [x1: dispatch `pr-reviewer` (constant)]
  when [x2: proposed change]
    request(e1, reviews.review, subject: x1, object: x2)
  response
    every [x3: review finding]
      on(x3, x2)
      scope [x4: grade]
        grade(x3) = x4
        name(e2, subject: x1, object: x4)
    every [x5: review finding]
      on(x5, x2)
      scope [x6: triage]
        triage(x5) = x6
        name(e3, subject: x1, object: x6)
review-guarantees#r9.line: When `pr-reviewer` reviews a proposed change, `pr-reviewer` shall name the grade of every review finding on the proposed change and the triage of every review finding on the proposed change.

reviews#r1.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `in-batch`
  when
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x3, object: x2)
  response [x5: proposed change]
    of(x5, x2)
    cite(subject: x5, object: x1)
    keep(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
reviews#r1.line: While an item in a batch is `in-batch`, when the person submits the batch, the batches service shall keep a proposed change of the batch that cites the item.

reviews#r2.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: item, x2: batch, x3: kept change]
    in(x1, x2)
    status(x1) = `needs-input`
    cite(subject: x3, object: x1)
  when
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x4, object: x2)
  response [x6: proposed change]
    of(x6, x2)
    not
      in(x3, x6)
    keep(e2, subject: x5, object: x6)
reviews#r2.line: While the status of an item in a batch is `needs-input` and a kept change cites the item, when the person submits the batch, the batches service shall keep a proposed change of the batch that does not hold the kept change.

reviews#r3.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: service the batches service (constant), x5: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: task, x2: batch]
    of(x1, x2)
    not
      status(x1) = `done`
  if
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x3, object: x2)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    name(e3, subject: x4, object: x1)
reviews#r3.line: While a task of a batch is not `done`, if the person submits the batch, then the batches service shall refuse the request and name the task.

reviews#r4.form:
shall [x6: agent the person (constant), x7: service the batches service (constant), x8: request "the request the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: workspace, x2: task, x3: batch, x4: kept change]
    of(x2, x3)
    of(x1, x2)
    not [x5: item]
      cite(subject: x4, object: x5)
    in(x4, x1)
  if
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x6, object: x3)
  response
    refuse(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
    name(e3, subject: x7, object: x4)
reviews#r4.line: While a workspace of a task of a batch holds a kept change that cites no item, if the person submits the batch, then the batches service shall refuse the request and name the kept change.

reviews#r5.form:
shall [x3: agent the person (constant), x4: service the batches service (constant)]
  while [x1: batch]
    status(x1) = `building`
    every [x2: task]
      of(x2, x1)
      scope
        status(x2) = `done`
  when
    request(e1, batches.submit, subject: x3, object: x1)
  response [x5: proposed change]
    of(x5, x1)
    keep(e2, subject: x4, object: x5)
    initiates(e3, subject: x4, status(x1) = `in-review`)
reviews#r5.line: While a batch is `building` and every task of the batch is `done`, when the person submits the batch, the batches service shall keep a proposed change of the batch and set the status of the batch to `in-review`.

scenarios#r1.form:

  while [x1: capability, x2: feature, x3: scenario]
    of(x2, x1)
    not [x4: requirement group]
      of(x3, x4)
    of(x3, x2)
  if
    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x5, object: x2)
    param(e1, audit, on)

    fail(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
    name(e3, subject: x6, object: x2)
    not [x8: file]
      change(e4, subject: x6, object: x8)
scenarios#r1.line: While the feature of a capability has a scenario that no requirement group has, if the person generates the feature of the capability with the audit, then the scenarios service shall fail the check, name the feature and change no file.

scenarios#r10.form:

  while [x1: requirement, x2: requirement group, x3: capability, x5: restriction]

    of(x1, x2)
    use(subject: x1, object: x4)
    of(x5, x1)
  when [x7: feature]
    of(x7, x3)
    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x6, object: x7)
  response [x9: scenario, x10: counter-example]
    of(x9, x2)
    of(x10, x9)
    keep(e2, subject: x8, object: x9)
    not [x11: step, x12: act]
      allow(subject: x1, object: x12)
      assert(subject: x11, object: x12)
      keep(e3, subject: x8, object: x11)
scenarios#r10.line: While a requirement of a requirement group of a capability uses `only` and the requirement has a restriction, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that has a counter-example and not keep a step that asserts an act that the requirement allows.

scenarios#r11.form:
shall [x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the scenarios service (constant)]
  while [x1: requirement, x2: requirement group, x3: capability, x4: upper bound]
    of(x2, x3)
    of(x1, x2)
    of(x4, x1)
  when [x6: feature]
    of(x6, x3)
    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response [x8: scenario, x9: counter-example]
    of(x8, x2)
    of(x9, x8)
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
scenarios#r11.line: While a requirement of a requirement group of a capability has an upper bound, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that has a counter-example.

  while [x1: requirement, x2: requirement group, x3: capability, x4: precondition]
    of(x2, x3)
    of(x1, x2)
    of(x4, x1)
    use(subject: x4, object: x5)
  when [x7: feature]

    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x6, object: x7)

    of(x9, x2)
    satisfy(subject: x9, object: x4)
    keep(e2, subject: x8, object: x9)
scenarios#r12.line: While the precondition of a requirement of a requirement group of a capability uses `every`, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that satisfies the precondition.

shall [x6: agent the person (constant), x8: service the scenarios service (constant)]
  while [x1: requirement, x2: requirement group, x3: capability, x4: precondition, x5: count]
    of(x2, x3)
    of(x1, x2)
    of(x4, x1)
    in(x5, x4)

scenarios#r13.line: While the precondition of a requirement of a requirement group of a capability holds a count, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that has the boundary of the count.

  while [x1: requirement, x2: capability]

    keep(e2, subject: x6, object: x7)
scenarios#r15.line: While a requirement of a capability uses `holds-exactly`, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario whose step uses `not-condition`.

scenarios#r16.form:
shall [x4: thing `nothing` (parameter), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the scenarios service (constant)]

    use(subject: x9, object: x4)
    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
scenarios#r16.line: While the precondition of a requirement of a capability uses `nothing`, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario whose step uses `nothing`.

scenarios#r17.form:
shall [x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the scenarios service (constant)]
  while [x1: requirement, x2: requirement group, x3: capability, x4: order]
    of(x2, x3)
    of(x1, x2)
    use(subject: x1, object: x4)
  when [x6: feature]
    of(x6, x3)
    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x5, object: x6)
  response [x8: scenario, x9: order counter-example]

    keep(e2, subject: x7, object: x8)
scenarios#r17.line: While a requirement of a requirement group of a capability uses an order, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario that has an order counter-example.

    of(x5, x6)

  when [x9: feature]

    request(e1, scenarios.generate, subject: x8, object: x9)

    of(x12, x11)
    keep(e2, subject: x10, object: x11)
scenarios#r18.line: While a term has two senses and a requirement of a requirement group of a capability uses the term and `order-by`, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that has an order counter-example.

scenarios#r19.form:
shall [x7: thing `order-by-every` (parameter), x8: agent the person (constant), x10: service the scenarios service (constant)]

scenarios#r19.line: While a term has two senses and a requirement of a requirement group of a capability uses the term and `order-by-every`, when the person generates the feature of the capability, the scenarios service shall keep a scenario of the requirement group that has an order counter-example.

scenarios#r2.form:
shall [x4: agent the person (constant), x5: service the scenarios service (constant), x6: check "the check the trigger makes" (indexical)]
  while [x1: step, x2: feature]
    of(x1, x2)
    not [x3: handler]
      of(x3, x1)

    name(e4, subject: x5, object: x2)
    not [x7: file]

scenarios#r2.line: While a step of a feature has no handler, if the person audits the feature, then the scenarios service shall fail the check, name the step, name the feature and change no file.

scenarios#r20.form:
shall [x3: thing `holds-exactly` (parameter), x4: thing `rc-object` (parameter), x5: agent the person (constant), x7: service the scenarios service (constant), x10: thing `not-condition` (parameter)]
